description: Edit a LONG-FORM 16:9 talking-head video in the MOTIONGRAPHICS style — a dark violet/magenta glow look built from lit glass tiles, self-building node diagrams, slam headlines on wiping violet bars, real media presented as rimmed cards on lit stages, continuous camera drift, and light-leak flash-through transitions. Uses HyperFrames (HTML→MP4) plus the HyperFrames catalog. This is the alternative to `nextphase-long-editing` (the coral dark-dotted-grid house style). Invoke when the user drops a recording and picks the "motiongraphics" style. In Video Studio the style comes from the studio job; never ask.
